lead: A dossier item owing "no Rust-side test carries its `covers:` marker" can be a marker to add rather than a test to write.
body: `Core\Csv::rows` already had two `#[test]`s in `csv.rs`'s own test module — one of them the bound that the walk holds a chunk and a record rather than the document, which no `.nvst` can see — and `--id` reported `0 Rust` only because neither carried the comment that attributes a Rust test. `grep -n '#\[test\]' -A 1` over the implementing file before budgeting the test: where a name for the claim already resolves, the slice is two comment lines.
